patch.summary: Railway cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Railway pricing is plan-gated across 5 researched tiers. Free entry: Free Trial, Free. 30-day trial documented. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.title: Railway plan matrix and who each tier suits
blocks.body: Structure and trial/free flags come from SoftwareGlimpse pricing research. Dollar amounts appear only when verified — never invent list prices.

blocks.heading: Railway cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Railway against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Free Trial, Free until a gated capability (premium unlock) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (infrastructure monitoring, log management, CI/CD and automation) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Does not outrank Render (7.9) as the cloud-paas award. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Teams that want a credited cloud PaaS with a published Hobby list price floor requires a paid unlock you will use weekly

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: Does not outrank Render (7.9) as the cloud-paas award

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Free list price credits and Free Trial are not production TCO — Hobby list price is the research floor; Pro list price is the team floor

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Not managed WordPress hosting (WP Engine) — landscape only

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Not ITSM, observability, git host, or a proxy network

blocks.body: Compare total cost of ownership vs Railway on identical constraints.
